question: Should the experimental Claws update preview expose only redacted, field-level capability descriptors with distinct escalation consent before this planner becomes the base for the apply workflow?
rationale: The implementation creates a new operator-facing security and consent boundary; code review cannot choose the permanent disclosure and approval semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve redacted field-level preview
options.body: Require redacted MCP descriptors, digests, focused regression coverage, and real current-head proof before accepting this planner as the stacked apply PR’s base.

options.title: Narrow the preview contract
options.body: Keep action summaries only and defer field-level capability values until maintainers define a broader consent and disclosure model.

options.title: Pause the Claws stack
options.body: Defer this planner and its dependent apply work until the RFC and lifecycle ownership model receive explicit product approval.

recommendation.title: Approve redacted field-level preview
recommendation.body: Require redacted MCP descriptors, digests, focused regression coverage, and real current-head proof before accepting this planner as the stacked apply PR’s base.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is assigned to this PR and previously reviewed the planner’s authoritative dry-run and ownership guarantees.
